Hi team —

Attached is a proposed single-paragraph insertion for Section 4.2 (Retention & Backup). The text is intentionally narrow and includes customer-controlled KMS, limited-access, and audit logging. I also recommend a short amendment to the Subprocessors clause clarifying that retention in backups by our infrastructure subprocessor is covered under the same access restrictions.

Proposed language (for Emma / PulseHealth counsel):
"Notwithstanding other provisions of this Agreement, Customer agrees that encrypted backups and archived copies of Customer Data may be retained for the purpose of disaster recovery, legal holds, and incident response for a period not to exceed seven (7) years from the date of creation, provided that: (i) such backups are encrypted at rest under Customer-managed keys where available; (ii) access to such backups is limited to designated on-call SREs under documented incident response procedures; and (iii) any access is logged and subject to audit by Customer upon reasonable notice. This retention of backups shall not be used for purposes of data analysis or additional processing beyond incident response and legal hold activities."

Attachments: PulseHealth_DPA_redline_v3.docx (with tracked changes). Please review. If this draft is acceptable, I'll prepare a 'clean' final DPA and a DocuSign package (signature order: Emma Hughes / PulseHealth -> Redwood Legal).
